create_file_with_pii_scrubbing: create a file at a given path with list or dict content and optional PII scrubbing
scrub_logs_content: scrub PII data from log content including strings, lists, and nested dictionaries
compress_downloaded_logs: compress a folder of downloaded logs into a zip archive at the given path
copy_file: copy a file from a source path to a destination path and return the new file path
get_file_name_from_path: extract and return the file name from a given full file path string
